answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that scales with the number of identities it claims, so a sybil farm pays a real, per-identity price instead of copying itself for free. Think of the stake as a bridge toll: crossing into the economy costs something each time, and the toll is held like a layer of shale under the road — cheap to walk once, ruinous to pave a thousand fake lanes. A fable of free identities dies when each copy must post collateral it loses if it cheats.
